note: The activity bound 2δ(32e/ρ)^k is the same as `fee^n * (2d)` with ρ = q. The scalar bound has ratio 32e/q in [L] (both maps use `Scout (q/4)`), weaker than [M]'s 2φ(16e/ρ)^k.

lemma exitP (q' : choir q)(he:Isometry e)(hv:DenseRange e)(hb:c≤k)
   (hV:Often (q/4) f x (1/4) c):∃ Q:FullVolume.Amp.Pulse Z Y k,Hits (f:=f) e x Q:=by
   obtain ⟨P,h,hP⟩:= FullVolume.Amp.stage e he hv hV; exact ⟨⟨P,fun n=>(h n).trans (mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by unfold FullVolume.Amp.fee; have hx:=q'.1; positivity) q'.2 _) hb (hV.pays.2) (by positivity))⟩,⟨hP⟩⟩

proof_context.conclusion: From `Often (q/4) f x (1/4) c` with an isometric dense `e`, `stage` gives a multilinear series with `‖P n‖ ≤ fee (q/4) (1/4)^n * c`, with `fee (q/4) (1/4) = 32e/q`.

lemma stage : ∃ (P:FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ I Y), (∀ n, ‖P n‖ ≤ fee p r^n*c) ∧ ∀ z,‖z‖≤r → HasSum (fun n=> P n (fun _=> e z)) (f (x+z)) := by
   choose P hP h using fun n:ℕ=> give (Y:=Y) e he h n; exact ⟨fun n=>P n (L.gardenL n),fun n=> (hP ..).trans (L.course n),fun z hz=> (L.party _ hz).congr_fun (fun n=>h n _ (fun _=>z))⟩

proof_context.conclusion: A series with `‖P n‖ ≤ fee p r ^ n * c` representing `f (x+z)` on `‖z‖ ≤ r` (here p = q/4, r = 1/4).
